description: REPOSITIONED FOR IMMEDIATE SALE  Unbeatable value for 3,000+ sq ft in the heart of Royal Oaks, Encino. This designer-updated Mid-Century retreat offers the most competitive price-per-square-foot. Experience the timeless appeal of Royal Oaks living in this beautifully updated Encino residence, ideally located just minutes from Beverly Hills and the Westside. Set on a lush and private 0.27-acre lot, this single-story Mid-Century retreat offers seamless indoor-outdoor living with thoughtfully designed spaces throughout. The home features over 3,000 sqft, 3 bedrooms and 3.5 bathrooms, along with a dedicated office that opens directly to the backyard-perfect for work, creativity, or quite retreat. A standout feature is the separate poolside structure with its own private entrance, offering exceptional flexibility as a guest suite, gym, studio, or additional workspace (not included in the main bedroom count). The chef's kitchen blends modern design with everyday functionality, featuring Sub-Zero refrigeration, Miele double ovens, quartz countertops, and sleek custom cabinetry-ideal for both entertaining and daily living. Outdoors, the property transforms into a true private sanctuary. Multiple expansive living areas, a resort-style pool, and a covered cabana create the perfect setting for relaxation or entertaining, all surrounded by mature landscaping that enhances privacy and tranquility. Additional highlights include solar power, security cameras, an advanced air-scrubber system, and low-maintenance, water-conserving turf. Located in the prestigious Royal Oaks neighborhood, just moments from Ventura Boulevard's dining and shopping, and offering convenient access to both the San Fernando Valley and the Westside-including proximity to top-rated schools-this home presents a rare opportunity to enjoy privacy, versatility, and prime location in one of Encino's most desirable enclaves.
